title: Container Bookings: Late Document Fees, Grace Periods and Free Allowance by Tier
content:
Shipping instructions and the verified gross mass (VGM) each have a cut-off on the allocated sailing. For every Container Bookings product this page gives the grace that follows each cut-off, the fee a late but accepted document attracts, and the number of late submissions that are logged free of charge.

## Tier values

| Booking product | Late shipping-instruction fee (USD per booking) | Grace after the SI cut-off (hours) | Late VGM fee (USD per container) | Grace after the VGM cut-off (hours) | Free late submissions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Spot Saver | 150.00 | 12 | 120.00 | 6 | 0 |
| AHL Spot Flex | 125.00 | 12 | 100.00 | 6 | 0 |
| AHL Contract Booking | 100.00 | 24 | 90.00 | 12 | 1 |
| AHL Contract Priority | 85.00 | 24 | 75.00 | 12 | 2 |
| AHL Guaranteed Loading | 100.00 | 24 | 90.00 | 12 | 1 |
| AHL Premium Express | 65.00 | 36 | 60.00 | 12 | 3 |

## Column notes

- The shipping-instruction fee is a single amount for the booking; the VGM fee is quoted per container.
- Grace is expressed in hours running on from the relevant cut-off.
- The last column is the free allowance: the number of late submissions entered at 0.00 before a late fee is charged. How earlier late submissions are counted against that allowance is laid down in the late-document rules of the product, not on this card.

## Tier contrasts

- AHL Spot Saver and AHL Spot Flex have no free allowance at all, so every late submission under them is charged.
- AHL Premium Express offers the longest shipping-instruction grace, 36 hours, and the lowest fees.
- VGM grace is 6 hours on the spot products and 12 hours on every other product.
